title: Authenticating Business Central Users with Microsoft Entra ID

facts.text: Microsoft Entra ID provides cloud-based identity and access for Business Central applications
Microsoft Entra authentication enables single sign-on integration with Excel, Outlook, Power BI, and Power Automate
OpenID Connect supported from version 20; WS-Federation deprecated in favor of OpenID Connect
Version 19 and earlier support only WS-Federation authentication
To switch version 20 or 21 from WS-Federation to OpenID Connect, enable ID tokens on registered application in Azure portal
Configure server with ValidAudiences parameter and webserver with AadApplicationId and AadAuthorityUri parameters
